en.bilal-muhammad: 13. Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim Natana (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Yahya al-Khazzaz from Ghiyath b. Ibrahim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from `Ali b. Abi Talib (a.s.), he said: "
Whoever mentions the name of Allah over food will never be asked about the blessing of that food."
